card.name: Neonatal sedation symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', and linking words inside lists of newborn sedation or withdrawal symptoms after benzodiazepine use in pregnancy. It also fires on opening parentheses and digits inside citations of years or percentages.
